opening_cutscene.speaker: Board Member
opening_cutscene.text: There's no doubting what you've achieved on a technical level. These are clearly state-of-the-art. There are just certain design choices that were made for these robots that we don't fully understand. We were hoping that you could shed some light on those.

opening_cutscene.speaker: William Afton
opening_cutscene.text: She can dance, she can sing, she's equipped with a built-in helium tank for inflating balloons right at her fingertips. She can take song requests. She can even dispense ice cream.

opening_cutscene.speaker: Board Member
opening_cutscene.text: With all due respect, those aren't the design choices we were curious about, Mr. Afton.

elizabeth_interludes.night_1: Daddy, why won't you let me play with her?
elizabeth_interludes.night_2: Daddy, you let the other children go see her. Why won't you let me go?
elizabeth_interludes.night_3: Daddy just once let me go play with her. She's so pretty and shiny. Didn't you make her just for me?
elizabeth_interludes.night_4: Daddy, she can make balloons! Have you seen her make balloons? Oh Daddy, let me go to her!

ballora_song: Why do you hide inside your walls, when there is music in my halls? All I see is an empty room, no more joy, an empty tomb. It's so good to sing all day, to dance, to spin, to fly away.
night_3_baby_story: Did you know that I was on stage once? It wasn't for very long, only one day. What a wonderful day, though.
I was in a small room with balloons and a few tables. No-one sat at the tables, though, but children would run in and out.
I always counted the children; I'm not sure why. I was always acutely aware of how many there were in the room with me.
Two, then three, then two, then three, then four, then two, then none. They usually played together in groups of two or three.
I was covered in glitter. I smelled like birthday cake. There were two, then three, then five, then four.
Then there was one. A little girl, standing by herself. I was no longer myself. And I stopped singing.
My stomach opened, and there was ice cream. I couldn't move, at least, not until she stepped closer.
There was screaming for a moment, but only for a moment. Then other children rushed in again, but they couldn't hear her over the sounds of their own excitement.
I still hear her sometimes. Why did that happen?

episode_1.speaker: Announcer
episode_1.text: As the sun sets, so also does another chapter in the saga of The Immortal and the Restless!

episode_1.speaker: Clara
episode_1.text: Vlad, you can't keep doing this! The baby is yours!

episode_1.speaker: Vlad
episode_1.text: Clara, I tell you, the baby isn't mine! Count the toes, that's no vampire baby!

episode_1.speaker: Clara
episode_1.text: He turns into a bat when he's angry, Vlad! And he only drinks blood-red cranberry juice!

episode_1.speaker: Vlad
episode_1.text: Lots of kids do that! Look, I'm a busy undead creature of the night, I don't have time for child support!

episode_2.speaker: Announcer
episode_2.text: Welcome back to The Immortal and the Restless!

episode_2.speaker: Clara
episode_2.text: Vlad! The baby burned down the nursery and slept in the ceiling rafters!

episode_2.speaker: Vlad
episode_2.text: Honestly Clara, boys will be boys! Maybe he's just an enthusiastic acrobat!

episode_2.speaker: Clara
episode_2.text: Then I'm taking the car, and I'm taking the diamond ring!

episode_3.speaker: Announcer
episode_3.text: Tonight on The Immortal and the Restless: passions ignite!

episode_3.speaker: Vlad
episode_3.text: Clara, I couldn't stay away. Your fiery temper warms my cold, undead heart.

episode_3.speaker: Clara
episode_3.text: Oh Vlad! I set your mansion on fire because I missed you so much!

episode_3.speaker: Vlad
episode_3.text: Wait, you burned down my ancestral manor?!

episode_4.speaker: Announcer
episode_4.text: The season finale of The Immortal and the Restless, sponsored by Exotic Butters!

episode_4.speaker: Vlad
episode_4.text: Clara, I've finally accepted the boy. Look how gracefully he hisses at the sun.

episode_4.speaker: Clara
episode_4.text: Oh Vlad, we're one big happy dysfunctional nocturnal family at last!

springtrap_monologue: I did it. I found it. It was right where you said it would be.
They were all there. They didn't recognize me at first, but then, they thought I was you.
And I found her. I put her back together, just like you asked me to. She's free now.
But something is wrong with me. I should be dead. But I'm not.
I've been living in shadows. There is only one thing left for me to do now.
I'm going to come find you.
I'm going to come find you.
